title: Minecraft HD(64x) Lootr Add-On
description: This add-on brings Minecraft HD(64x) textures to Lootr.
body:
This add-on brings [Minecraft HD(64x)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/minecraft-hd(64x)-fan-updated-by-mrdhobbs) textures to the [Lootr](https://modrinth.com/mod/lootr) mod.

Lootr is a mod that makes all loot chests instanced per player and visually unique. Useful on SMP, so everyone has a chance to collect loot from structures.
